mapper.select: select id, attempt_id, test_id, user_info_id, question_id, question_no, answer_value, create_time, update_time from personality_test_answer where attempt_id = #{attemptId} order by question_no asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into personality_test_answer (attempt_id, test_id, user_info_id, question_id, question_no, answer_value, create_time, update_time) values (#{attemptId}, #{testId}, #{userInfoId}, #{questionId}, #{questionNo}, #{answerValue}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update answer_value = values(answer_value), update_time = values(update_time)
